summary: Short 16 m kerb at a shop-front loading zone on a main road.

best_section.where: Hawken Drive east kerb at the shops, beside the side-street junction and shop car park

drivers.seclusion: Nearest dwellings are 19 m or more away, but the kerb is in front of retail and a busy shop car park.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is partly the mouth of a side street and a shop car park entrance; hardly a van length of usable kerb.
drivers.traffic: Busy main road with shops, a school-crossing marking and constant turning traffic.
drivers.convention: Commercial loading zone 20 min max, 2P parking and mail zone signs; not an overnight spot.

flags: Loading zone signs on the stretch
Shop car park beside it is customers only
sun_shade: Partial tree shade from the north and west; open to the east.
cannot_judge: Exact sign positions on the kerb
